The installed firmware and its version cannot be reliably identified through public Android APIs. Manufacturer hints below may help, but a custom ROM or different menu names are possible.
Notifications and background work
Android currently allows timer notifications. Their appearance and delivery still depend on the system.
Notification permission has not been granted. You can allow it with the button below or continue without system timer controls.
Notification permission is denied. You can review it in Android settings or continue using the timer in the app.
Android notifications are disabled for OTM. You can review them in settings; time tracking in the app remains available.
The timer notification channel is blocked. Review this channel in Android settings if you want system controls.
Allow notifications
Android Battery Saver is off.
Android reports no app background restriction. Manufacturer limits and autostart settings are not visible in this check.
The Android background restriction status could not be read. Review the app’s system settings if controls stop updating.
The Battery Saver status could not be read.
Change battery or autostart settings only if controls stop updating. Keep normal battery protection unless a specific problem requires a change. This wizard never requests a battery exemption.
Choose your timer controls
Each option below is voluntary. Adding a tile or widget needs your confirmation in Android or your launcher. Live Updates remain off until you turn them on.
This Android version supports asking to add a Quick Settings tile. The system can decline the request.
On this Android version, add the OTM tile with the Quick Settings editor.
Your launcher reports support for widget pin requests. Placement still needs confirmation.
Your launcher does not offer in-app widget pinning. Try its widget picker instead.
Widget pin support could not be read. You can try the launcher’s widget picker.
After Done or Skip, setup will not open automatically again. Reopen it from Settings → Android and device. The choice stays on this device and is excluded from OTM backups.
Setup closed, but the local choice could not be saved. It may appear again when you reopen the app.
